verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no published disclosure of how CMS IndusLaw itself uses AI in client service: no named tools, no AI-use policy, and no proprietary AI-practice products. The TMC page only says the firm advises clients on AI as a legal subject. That is an adjacent practice area, not the firm's own use of AI in delivering services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
